purpose: Prioritize research and review work across the accounting landscape. Breadth metrics are inventory diagnostics; scoped assessments are the evidence-review measure.
population: The canonical records in the stated corpus version; no records are excluded from mapping-status totals.
time_basis: Point-in-time versioned corpus snapshots, not source publication dates or evidence currency. The headline totals always describe the entire corpus, independent of the exploration filters.

definitions.title: Scoped research assessments
definitions.numerator: Assessments with a stated industry code, question family, scope and review basis
definitions.caveat: A partial or not-applicable assessment is not adequate coverage. Inspect status, seven depth dimensions, evidence and remaining gaps.

definitions.title: Question families with material
definitions.numerator: Question families referenced by at least one candidate or reviewed record mapping
definitions.denominator: All question families in the stated topology version
definitions.caveat: Adding a keyword association can raise this number without adding evidence. It does not measure sufficiency or source quality.

definitions.title: Sectors with associated material
definitions.numerator: Sectors with at least one record mapped at the sector or a descendant code
definitions.denominator: All sectors in the stated industry edition
definitions.caveat: Upward aggregation is useful for locating material. No downward credit is assigned to a subsector or detailed industry.

definitions.title: Records without question assignments
definitions.numerator: Records whose question_mappings array is empty
definitions.denominator: All canonical records in the stated corpus version
definitions.caveat: Unassigned records can still be relevant. A proposed assignment is not editorial review.

definitions.title: Industry mapping disposition
definitions.numerator: Mutually exclusive counts of specific, shared-context and unassigned industry scopes
definitions.denominator: All canonical records in the stated corpus version
definitions.caveat: These three counts must sum to the corpus total. Individual industry rows can overlap and must not be added together.

comparison_rule: Compare snapshots only after reconciling corpus populations, topology editions, mapping methods and assessment definitions. A changed mapping method can change counts with no new research.
target_policy: No completeness percentage or unsupported numerical target is assigned. Zero direct material, unassigned metadata, unassessed evidence and not-applicable findings remain distinct.
